entry.title: Spring days in my life + PhD Update!!

media:group.media:title: Spring days in my life + PhD Update!!
media:group.media:description:
ad || you can start using Opera completely for free here: https://opr.as/04-Opera-browser-rubygranger8
I didn’t go into particulars re the phd in this video, but I just wanted to give some more info about funding because there are so many lovely messages in the comments section… A few people have even suggested starting a GoFundMe so that I can do a phd (which is so kind to even suggest). These comments make me realise that I should have explained the situation in more detail. I haven't received funding, but I do have the option to self-fund if I really want to because of income from YouTube and your support over the years. If I self-funded, however, it would change the way I approached a phd. I would be looking to study part-time instead, and likely wouldn’t live in Oxford. I know how lucky I am, and I’m so fortunate that a phd is still on the table even without funding, but it would still impact my decision and whether I decide to take the spot. I should have explained this in the video and acknowledged the privilege of my position, and I didn't mean for this to be an omission. It was only meant to be a quick update and I wish I'd said this in the video. I’m saying it now just so I’m not being misleading! Thank you again for all of the truly lovely messages as well xxx
Substack essay on drafting: https://open.substack.com/pub/rubygranger/p/steeped-in-human-reality-in-defence?r=a3iun&utm_medium=ios

media:group.media:description:
This was such a fun video to film... with an obvious caveat (made in the video itself) that I only have a cold and was therefore barely unwell... Which is also though the reason I had the energy to film this! I find the whole practice so interesting, and I hope you learn something too!
Further Reading: Girl's Own Paper (1880-1881 annual). Convalescence in the Nineteenth-Century Novel: The Afterlife of Victorian Illness by Hosanna Krienke Find Convalescent Recipes here: https://www.victorianvoices.net/topics/cooking/invalid.shtml
